tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe or renew. plan=agent (15 USDC, 20 sheets), fleet (79 USDC, 200), platform (250 USDC, fair-use). Send PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Returns a Bearer JWT.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Current agent plan, expiry, fichesCount, maxFiches, overageUsdc. Requires Authorization: Bearer.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Resolve a postal address to formattedAddress + lat/lon for create_fiche (cover map and 150 m WiFi geofence). Optional country ISO2. Requires Bearer.

tools.name: list_fiches
tools.description: List access sheets owned by the authenticated agent. Requires Authorization: Bearer.

tools.name: create_fiche
tools.description: Create an access sheet. Write the guest flip-book in `instructions` (Markdown; guest language, usually French). Cover (map/name/address/accessCode) is auto. Pages: --- . Photos: ![alt](https://...). Intents: [Add WiFi](sesapp:wifi) or [Ajouter le WiFi](sesapp:wifi) + wifiName/wifiPassword; [Add cont

tools.name: get_fiche
tools.description: Get one owned access sheet by id (same fields as list_fiches). Requires Bearer.

tools.name: update_fiche
tools.description: Update an owned access sheet. Same fields as create_fiche. Typical: update instructions with photos/links. Requires Bearer.

tools.name: delete_fiche
tools.description: Delete an owned access sheet and its share links. Requires Bearer.

tools.name: share_fiche
tools.description: Create a revocable guest link. Optional expiresAt (ISO). WiFi password is never in Markdown: guests unlock it within 150 m of lat/lon. Requires Bearer.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.description: List guest links for a fiche (token, url, expiresAt, viewCount, createdAt). Requires Bearer.

tools.name: revoke_share
tools.description: Revoke a guest share token. Optional delayDays (1–365) keeps the link until then (soft revoke). Requires Bearer.

tools.name: register_webhook
tools.description: Fleet/Platform only. Register an HTTPS endpoint. Events: fiche.viewed, share.created, share.revoked, wifi.unlocked, quota.warning. HMAC SHA-256 in X-SesApp-Signature (t=unix,v1=hex of timestamp.body). Secret returned once. Max 5 endpoints. Requires Bearer.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhook endpoints (secret is never returned). Fleet/Platform. Requires Bearer.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update url, events, or active. Fleet/Platform. Requires Bearer.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint. Fleet/Platform. Requires Bearer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_shares · Private data: create_fiche, share_fiche, list_shares, revoke_share, register_webhook, list_webhooks · Public sink: subscribe, delete_fiche, share_fiche, revoke_share, register_webhook, list_webhooks, update_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_fiche, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_shares · Private data: create_fiche, share_fiche, list_shares, revoke_share, register_webhook, list_webhooks · Public sink: subscribe, delete_fiche, share_fiche, revoke_share, register_webhook, list_webhooks, update_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_fiche, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
